topic: Someone discovers their neighbor is secretly wealthy
text: I can't believe it. All this time, we've been struggling to make ends meet, and she's been living in luxury right next door, hiding it behind those closed curtains. Dresses from Milan, cars that cost more than my house, and she had the nerve to come to our block party with a gift bought from a thrift store. How dare she look us in the eye, act like she's one of us, when she's been swimming in cash? I've been volunteering at the food bank, and she's been funding her designer lifestyle. The nerve! I'm done. I can’t stand to pretend I don’t see it anymore.
